questions.question: Do you have any books on your bookshelf for many years? Instead of throwing them away, here is another way for you. If you have books that you won’t read anymore, you can share them with others. You can take the books to Share and Read. We welcome all quality books. But we don’t want textbooks, magazines and dictionaries. Just make sure that your books are in good condition before giving them to us. We are looking forward to seeing you at Share and Read!
